caption: The video showcases a top-down view of a plain white surface holding a cube-shaped frame assembled from many small silver magnetic spheres. A hairy left forearm extends from the left side, and the left hand grips one vertical edge of the sphere frame near its middle. A right hand holds a white rectangular card to the right of the structure, its corner showing a small punched hole as the clip continues. The right hand moves the card leftward until its edge meets the right side of the magnetic frame. After contact, the card is held steady against the frame while the left hand maintains its grip. The left hand then shifts along the edge and draws a horizontal row of spheres inward toward the cube's interior. This pull bends that row away from its original straight alignment, creating a localized curved segment. The rest of the cube frame remains in place, and the process is still underway at the final frame.
